summary: Audited the Resend key and the legacy-cleanup work. BACKEND: Resend works with the new key. Finalizing a registration via POST /api/track/registration produces 'POST https://api.resend.com/emails 200 OK' and '[email] enviado: Inscrição realizada com sucesso -> delivered@resend.dev' in the backend logs, from both pytest and the real UI flow. No 401/403. GET /api/admin/inscricoes/lembrete-pagamento/resumo returns 200 with total/ja_enviados_hoje/pendentes/hoje when authenticated, and 401/403 without auth. FRONTEND: the full E2E flow passed on desktop 1920 and mobile 390: termos Inscrever-se -> inscricao (doc uploads required) -> dados (VAGA=DELEGADO, MUNICIPIO=MACAPÁ) -> confirmacao (Confirmar Inscrição) -> inscricao-realizada (R$ 200,00, Pagar Inscrição) -> pagamento-pix (QR, copia-e-cola with MACAPA, R$ 200,00). No JS pageerrors and no horizontal overflow (scrollWidth equals the viewport). Layout is unchanged: white Cesgranrio navbar, blue footer in #cg-footer-host (rgb(34,56,116) on termos), and no #cebraspe-footer or .ceb-* elements in the DOM. ADMIN: /donaspainel login works, Inscrições listing works, and the 'Enviar lembrete de pagamento' button fetches the resumo and shows a native confirm ('...para 4 inscrito(s)...'). I dismissed it so no reminders went to real candidates. Configurações shows the Pix fields with placeholder 'Ex: MACAPA'. SOURCE GREP: there are no unesp/vunesp/cebraspe/concursoseduc/seplag/fortaleza strings in frontend/public (inicio.html excluded) or in backend/*.py. The only remaining 'seduc' matches are internal identifiers: the /seduc/ asset folder, .seduc-footer, seducFinalizar and seduc-header-host.

design_issues.screen: Short pages (e.g. pagamento-pix while loading, mobile)
issues: Light grey body shows below the blue footer when the content is short. The footer is not pinned to the bottom. Cosmetic only, and may be pre-existing.

Optional: rename the internal 'seduc' identifiers (/seduc/ folder, .seduc-footer, window.seducFinalizar, seduc-header-host) if no trace of the old project should remain. They are not user-visible.
critical_code_review_comments: The email is sent in the uppercased form typed in the UI (DELIVERED@RESEND.DEV). It works, but lowercasing emails before storing and sending would be better.
The lembrete flow uses native alert/confirm dialogs. They work, but don't match the rest of the admin UI.
seed_data_creation: Created and then deleted: CPF 52998224725 (TEST E2E CANDIDATO, UI flow) and CPF 11144477735 (TEST_RESEND_CANDIDATO, pytest). Both removed, along with their cadastros.
context_for_next_testing_agent: On inscricao.html, DOC_FRENTE and DOC_VERSO uploads are required by JS. Use set_input_files with a 1x1 PNG, otherwise the form won't advance. The admin login submit is data-testid=admin-login-submit (it is not type=submit). The lembrete button is data-testid=btn-enviar-lembrete-pagamento and uses a native confirm: dismiss it so no real emails go out. Run python backend/tests/cleanup_e2e.py afterwards. The browser tool strips '#' inside scripts, so avoid '#' in JS strings.
